Explain the example for write a named document

blocks.text: setDoc writes fields at a document path you choose. Without merge, it replaces the document data at that path.

Use the Firebase Emulator Suite with the demo-reading-club project and Firestore on port 8080. Install the firebase JavaScript SDK in a local browser project. Run each full snippet on a fresh page. Keep the sample rules local.

blocks.title: Write a named document

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `setDoc` writes at a chosen document path. Without merge, supplied data replaces that document's data.
`connectFirestoreEmulator` sends this SDK instance to the local emulator address before database operations begin.

blocks.text: With local rules allowing the sample write, books/moon-trip contains the two fields.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Know whether replacing the whole document is intended. Use merge or update when preserving other fields matters.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Write a second sample document with a different id.
